.swal2-popup.rhn-fs .swal2-title{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:800!important;text-align:left!important;margin:0!important;padding:18px 60px 12px 18px!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg2);line-height:1.3;word-break:break-word;flex:0 0 auto;}
.swal2-popup.rhn-fs .swal2-html-container{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;margin:0!important;padding:14px 16px!important;overflow-y:auto!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;max-width:100%;}
.swal2-popup.rhn-fs .swal2-actions{flex:0 0 auto;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin:0!important;padding:12px 16px!important;border-top:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--bg2);}
.swal2-popup.rhn-fs .swal2-validation-message{margin:0;}
.swal2-popup.rhn-fs .swal2-close{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:absolute!important;z-index:5;top:10px!important;right:10px!important;width:38px!important;height:38px!important;font-size:28px!important;color:var(--text)!important;background:var(--bg2)!important;border:1px solid var(--border2)!important;border-radius:50%!important;line-height:1!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;}
.swal2-popup.rhn-fs div[style*="max-height"]{max-height:none!important;}
.swal2-container.rhn-edgec{padding:0!important;align-items:flex-end!important;}
.swal2-popup.rhn-edge{position:relative!important;transform:none!important;width:100vw!important;max-width:100vw!important;max-height:100dvh;margin:0!important;border-radius:0!important;border:none!important;border-top:1px solid var(--border2)!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding-bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 14px)!important;overflow-y:auto;box-sizing:border-box;}
.swal2-popup.rhn-edge .swal2-html-container{max-width:100%;margin-left:12px!important;margin-right:12px!important;}
#legal-gate{padding:0!important;}
#legal-gate>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-height:none!important;border-radius:0!important;border:none!important;}
#ai-book-ov{padding:0!important;}
#ai-book-ov .abk-box{max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;border-radius:0!important;border:none!important;}
.rhn-fs-x{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:10px;right:10px;width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--border2);border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text);font-size:26px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;}
}
</style>
<script id="rhn-fs-script">
(function(){
  var mq=window.matchMedia('(max-width:767px)');
  function apply(pop){
    pop.classList.remove('rhn-fs');
    if(pop.parentElement)pop.parentElement.classList.remove('rhn-fsc');
    pop.classList.add('opt-pop');
    var sc=pop.querySelector('.swal2-close');
    var vis=sc&&getComputedStyle(sc).display!=='none';
    if(!vis&&!pop.querySelector('.opt-x')&&!pop.querySelector('.rhn-fs-x')){
      var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='rhn-fs-x';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Tutup');b.innerHTML='&times;';
      b.onclick=function(){try{Swal.close();}catch(e){}};pop.appendChild(b);
    }
  }
  function check(pop){
    if(!mq.matches){
      if(pop.classList.contains('ah-popup')||pop.classList.contains('swal2-toast')||pop.classList.contains('sv-pop')||pop.classList.contains('swal2-loading'))return;
      if(pop.classList.contains('opt-pop')||pop.offsetHeight>window.innerHeight*0.5){
        pop.classList.add('opt-pop');
        var sc2=pop.querySelector('.swal2-close');
        var vis2=sc2&&getComputedStyle(sc2).display!=='none';
        if(!vis2&&!pop.querySelector('.opt-x')&&!pop.querySelector('.rhn-fs-x')){
          var b2=document.createElement('button');b2.type='button';b2.className='rhn-fs-x';b2.setAttribute('aria-label','Tutup');b2.innerHTML='&times;';
          b2.onclick=function(){try{Swal.close();}catch(e){}};pop.appendChild(b2);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    if(pop.classList.contains('ah-popup')||pop.classList.contains('swal2-toast')||pop.classList.contains('sv-pop')||pop.classList.contains('opt-pop'))return;
    if(pop.classList.contains('swal2-loading'))return;
    var big=pop.offsetHeight>window.innerHeight*0.5||pop.classList.contains('rhn-fs');
    if(big){
      if(pop.classList.contains('rhn-edge')){pop.classList.remove('rhn-edge');if(pop.parentElement)pop.parentElement.classList.remove('rhn-edgec');}
      apply(pop);
    }else if(!pop.classList.contains('rhn-edge')){
      pop.classList.add('rhn-edge');if(pop.parentElement)pop.parentElement.classList.add('rhn-edgec');
    }
  }
  function watch(c){
    var pop=c.querySelector('.swal2-popup');if(!pop||pop.__rhnW)return;pop.__rhnW=1;
    var run=function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){check(pop);});};
    run();
    try{new ResizeObserver(run).observe(pop);}catch(e){}
    try{new MutationObserver(run).observe(pop,{childList:true,subtree:true});}catch(e){}
    try{new MutationObserver(run).observe(pop,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});}catch(e){}
  }
  new MutationObserver(function(ms){
    ms.forEach(function(m){m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){if(n.nodeType===1&&n.classList&&n.classList.contains('swal2-container'))watch(n);});});
  }).observe(document.body,{childList:true});
})();
</script>
<script id="rhn-keypad">
(function(){
  var coarse=function(){try{return window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches||('ontouchstart' in window&&window.innerWidth<=900);}catch(e){return false;}};
  function fire(inp){inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}
  window.rhnBuildKeypad=function(inp){
    if(!inp)return null;
    var max=parseInt(inp.getAttribute('maxlength'))||6;
    var wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='rhn-kp';
    var keys=['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','','0','x'];
    keys.forEach(function(k){
      var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';
      if(k===''){b.className='rhn-kp-ghost';b.tabIndex=-1;}
      else if(k==='x'){b.className='rhn-kp-x';b.innerHTML='&#9003;';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Hapus');}
      else b.textContent=k;
      b.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){e.preventDefault();});
      b.addEventListener('click',function(e){
        e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
        if(k==='')return;
        if(k==='x'){inp.value=inp.value.slice(0,-1);fire(inp);return;}
        if(inp.value.length>=max)return;
        inp.value=inp.value+k;fire(inp);
      });
      wrap.appendChild(b);
    });
    return wrap;
  };
  window.rhnForceNumeric=function(inp){
    if(!inp)return;
    inp.setAttribute('inputmode','none');inp.readOnly=true;inp.dataset.kp='1';
    if(inp.dataset.gkp){delete inp.dataset.gkp;}
    if(window.rhnGkpHide)window.rhnGkpHide();
    inp.setAttribute('autocomplete','one-time-code');
  };
  // Popup PIN (SweetAlert): paksa angka murni lewat keypad sendiri
  window.rhnSwalKeypad=function(popup){
    try{
      if(!coarse())return;
      var inp=(popup||document).querySelector('.swal2-input');
      if(!inp)return;
      window.rhnForceNumeric(inp);
      var kp=window.rhnBuildKeypad(inp);
      if(kp)inp.parentNode.insertBefore(kp,inp.nextSibling);
      inp.focus=function(){};
      [60,200,500].forEach(function(t){setTimeout(function(){if(window.rhnGkpHide)window.rhnGkpHide();},t);});
      var hc=(popup||document).querySelector('.swal2-html-container');
      var top0=function(){if(hc)hc.scrollTop=0;};
      top0();[0,50,150,350,700].forEach(function(t){setTimeout(top0,t);});
    }catch(e){}
  };
  // Layar PIN utama
  function initMain(){
    var inp=document.getElementById('app-pin');
    if(!inp||inp.dataset.kp||!coarse())return;
    inp.dataset.kp='1';
    window.rhnForceNumeric(inp);
    var kp=window.rhnBuildKeypad(inp);
    if(kp){var row=inp.closest('.form-row')||inp.parentNode;row.parentNode.insertBefore(kp,row.nextSibling);}
    var ps=document.getElementById('pin-screen');if(ps)ps.style.overflowY='auto';
  }
  function initQuick(){
    var q=document.getElementById('auth-quickcode');
    if(!q||q.dataset.kp||!coarse())return;
    q.dataset.kp='1';
    window.rhnForceNumeric(q);
    var kp=window.rhnBuildKeypad(q);
    if(kp)q.parentNode.appendChild(kp);
  }
  initMain();initQuick();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){initMain();initQuick();});
})();
</script>
<script id="rhn-gkp-script">
(function(){
  var coarse=function(){try{return window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches||('ontouchstart' in window&&window.innerWidth<=900);}catch(e){return false;}};
  if(!coarse())return;
  var panel,cur=null,hideT=null,panelTouch=0;
  function isNum(el){
    if(!el||el.tagName!=='INPUT'||el.dataset.kp||el.dataset.gkpSkip)return false;
    if(el.dataset.gkp)return true;
    var t=(el.getAttribute('type')||'text').toLowerCase();
    var im=(el.getAttribute('inputmode')||'').toLowerCase();
    return t==='number'||t==='tel'||im==='numeric'||im==='decimal';
  }
  function prep(el){
    if(!isNum(el)||el.dataset.gkp)return;
    var t=(el.getAttribute('type')||'text').toLowerCase();
    var im=(el.getAttribute('inputmode')||'').toLowerCase();
    var dec=(im==='decimal')||el.hasAttribute('step');
    el.dataset.gkp='1';
    el.dataset.gkpSep=(t==='number')?'.':',';
    if(dec)el.dataset.gkpDec='1';
    var oi=(el.getAttribute('oninput')||'');
    if(oi.indexOf('__rpFmt')>-1||el.id==='ht-kor-amt')el.dataset.gkpNeg='1';
    if((el.getAttribute('onfocus')||'').indexOf('select')>-1)el.dataset.gkpFresh='1';
    if(t==='number'&&dec){try{el.type='text';}catch(e){}}
    el.setAttribute('inputmode','none');
    el.readOnly=true;
  }
  function scan(root){
    try{
      if(root.nodeType!==1)return;
      if(root.tagName==='INPUT')prep(root);
      var l=root.querySelectorAll?root.querySelectorAll('input'):[];
      for(var i=0;i<l.length;i++)prep(l[i]);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function build(){
    if(panel)return;
    panel=document.createElement('div');panel.id='rhn-gkp';
    var top=document.createElement('div');top.className='gkp-top';
    var neg=document.createElement('button');neg.type='button';neg.className='gkp-neg';neg.textContent='\u2212';neg.dataset.k='neg';
    var done=document.createElement('button');done.type='button';done.className='gkp-done';done.textContent='SELESAI';done.dataset.k='done';
    top.appendChild(neg);top.appendChild(done);panel.appendChild(top);
    var g=document.createElement('div');g.className='gkp-grid';
    ['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','dec','0','bk'].forEach(function(k){
      var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.dataset.k=k;b.tabIndex=-1;
      if(k==='bk'){b.className='gkp-x';b.innerHTML='&#9003;';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Hapus');}
      else if(k==='dec'){b.className='gkp-dec';b.textContent=',';}
      else b.textContent=k;
      g.appendChild(b);
    });
    panel.appendChild(g);
    panel.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){e.preventDefault();panelTouch=Date.now();});
    panel.addEventListener('touchstart',function(){panelTouch=Date.now();},{passive:true});
    panel.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
      e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();panelTouch=Date.now();
      press(b.dataset.k);
    });
    document.body.appendChild(panel);
  }
  function fire(el,n){el.dispatchEvent(new Event(n,{bubbles:true}));}
  function press(k){
    var el=cur;
    if(!el||!document.contains(el)){hide();return;}
    if(k==='done'){commit(el);try{el.blur();}catch(e){}hide();return;}
    var v=el.value||'';
    var max=parseInt(el.getAttribute('maxlength'))||0;
    if(el._fresh&&k!=='bk'&&k!=='neg'){v='';el._fresh=false;}else if(k==='bk'){el._fresh=false;}
    if(k==='bk'){v=v.slice(0,-1);}
    else if(k==='neg'){v=(v.charAt(0)==='-')?v.slice(1):'-'+v;}
    else if(k==='dec'){
      if(!el.dataset.gkpDec)return;
      var sep=el.dataset.gkpSep||',';
      if(v.indexOf(sep)>-1||(sep===','&&/,/.test(v)))return;
      v=(v===''||v==='-')?v+'0'+sep:v+sep;
    }else{
      if(max>0&&v.length>=max)return;
      v=v+k;
    }
    el.value=v;fire(el,'input');
  }
  function commit(el){
    if(el&&el._v0!==undefined&&el.value!==el._v0){el._v0=el.value;fire(el,'change');}
  }
  function show(el){
    build();
    clearTimeout(hideT);
    cur=el;el._v0=el.value;el._fresh=!!el.dataset.gkpFresh&&el.value.length>0;
    panel.querySelector('.gkp-neg').style.visibility=el.dataset.gkpNeg?'visible':'hidden';
    var d=panel.querySelector('.gkp-dec');
    if(el.dataset.gkpDec){d.textContent=el.dataset.gkpSep||',';d.style.visibility='visible';}else{d.style.visibility='hidden';}
    panel.classList.add('open');document.body.classList.add('rhn-kp-open');
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--kp-h',panel.offsetHeight+'px');
    setTimeout(function(){try{if(cur===el)el.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});}catch(e){}},150);
  }
  function hide(){
    clearTimeout(hideT);cur=null;
    if(panel)panel.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.classList.remove('rhn-kp-open');
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--kp-h','0px');
  }
  window.rhnGkpHide=hide;
  document.addEventListener('focusin',function(e){
    var el=e.target;
    if(el&&el.tagName==='INPUT'&&!el.dataset.gkp)prep(el);
    if(isNum(el)&&el.dataset.gkp){
      if(cur&&cur!==el)commit(cur);
      show(el);
    }
  },true);
  document.addEventListener('focusout',function(e){
    var el=e.target;
    if(el!==cur)return;
    commit(el);
    clearTimeout(hideT);
    hideT=setTimeout(function(){
      if(Date.now()-panelTouch<500)return;
      var a=document.activeElement;
      if(a&&a!==el&&a.dataset&&a.dataset.gkp)return;
      if(a===cur)return;
      hide();
    },380);
  },true);
  setInterval(function(){if(cur&&!document.contains(cur))hide();},500);
  var q=[],sched=false;
  new MutationObserver(function(ms){
    ms.forEach(function(m){for(var i=0;i<m.addedNodes.length;i++)q.push(m.addedNodes[i]);});
    if(!sched&&q.length){sched=true;requestAnimationFrame(function(){var a=q;q=[];sched=false;a.forEach(scan);});}
  }).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  scan(document.documentElement);
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){scan(document.documentElement);});
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ===== BUKA APLIKASI DENGAN SIDIK JARI (WebAuthn, tersimpan lokal per perangkat) ===== */
(function(){
  var K = function(u){ return 'rhn_bio_' + u; }, ASK = function(u){ return 'rhn_bio_asked_' + u; };
  var uid = function(){ try { return localStorage.getItem('last_uid_rhn'); } catch(e){ return null; } };
  var rnd = function(n){ var a = new Uint8Array(n); crypto.getRandomValues(a); return a; };
  var b64 = function(buf){ var b = new Uint8Array(buf), s=''; for (var i=0;i<b.length;i++) s += String.fromCharCode(b[i]); return btoa(s); };
  var unb64 = function(t){ var s = atob(t), a = new Uint8Array(s.length); for (var i=0;i<s.length;i++) a[i] = s.charCodeAt(i); return a; };
  var SW = function(o){ o.background = 'var(--card)'; o.color = 'var(--text)'; if (!o.confirmButtonColor) o.confirmButtonColor = '#0F8A63'; return window.Swal ? Swal.fire(o) : Promise.resolve({}); };
  var supported = async function(){
    try {
      if (!window.isSecureContext || !window.PublicKeyCredential || !navigator.credentials) return false;
      return !!(await PublicKeyCredential.isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable());
    } catch(e){ return false; }
  };
  var enabled = function(){ var u = uid(); try { return !!(u && localStorage.getItem(K(u))); } catch(e){ return false; } };
  var inVerify = function(){ var m = window.pinMode; return !(m === 'setup' || m === 'setup_offline'); };

  function refresh(){
    var b = document.getElementById('bio-set-btn'), t = document.getElementById('bio-set-sub'), on = enabled();
    if (b) b.textContent = on ? 'MATIKAN' : 'AKTIFKAN';
    if (t) t.textContent = on ? 'Aktif: buka aplikasi cukup dengan sidik jari di perangkat ini' : 'Buka aplikasi dengan sidik jari atau face unlock';
    var bb = document.getElementById('bio-btn'), ps = document.getElementById('pin-screen');
    if (bb) bb.style.display = (on && inVerify() && ps && ps.style.display !== 'none') ? 'block' : 'none';
  }
  window.rhnBioRefresh = refresh;

  window.rhnBioEnable = async function(){
    var u = uid(); if (!u) return false;
    if (location.protocol === 'file:') {
      SW({ icon:'info', title:'Buka Lewat Website', text:'Sidik jari tidak bisa dipakai kalau file dibuka dari komputer (alamat C:/...). Upload file ke hosting HTTPS (misalnya Cloudflare Pages atau GitHub Pages), lalu buka lewat alamat websitenya.' });
      return false;
    }
    if (!(await supported())) {
      SW({ icon:'info', title:'Belum Didukung', text:'Perangkat atau browser ini belum mendukung sidik jari, atau halaman tidak dibuka lewat HTTPS. Pastikan sidik jari sudah terdaftar di pengaturan HP.' });
      return false;
    }
    try {
      var rp = { name:'RHN Capital' }; if (location.hostname) rp.id = location.hostname;
      var c = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey: {
        challenge: rnd(32), rp: rp,
        user: { id: new TextEncoder().encode(u).slice(0,64), name: 'rhn-' + u.slice(0,8), displayName: 'RHN Capital' },
        pubKeyCredParams: [{type:'public-key', alg:-7}, {type:'public-key', alg:-257}],
        authenticatorSelection: { authenticatorAttachment:'platform', userVerification:'required', residentKey:'discouraged' },
        timeout: 60000, attestation: 'none'
      }});
      if (!c) return false;
      localStorage.setItem(K(u), b64(c.rawId));
      refresh();
      if (window.showSaveSuccess) window.showSaveSuccess('Sidik Jari Aktif!', 1200);
      return true;
    } catch(e){
      if (!e || e.name !== 'NotAllowedError') SW({ icon:'error', title:'Gagal Mengaktifkan', text:'Sidik jari tidak berhasil didaftarkan. Coba lagi.' });
      return false;
    }
  };
  window.rhnBioDisable = function(){ var u = uid(); if (u) localStorage.removeItem(K(u)); refresh(); if (window.showSaveSuccess) window.showSaveSuccess('Sidik Jari Dimatikan', 1000); };
  window.rhnBioToggle = function(){ if (enabled()) window.rhnBioDisable(); else window.rhnBioEnable(); };

  window.rhnBioUnlock = async function(manual){
    var u = uid(), id = u && localStorage.getItem(K(u)); if (!id || window.appUnlocked) return;
    if (window.__bioBusy) return; window.__bioBusy = true;
    try {
      var o = { challenge: rnd(32), allowCredentials: [{ type:'public-key', id: unb64(id), transports:['internal'] }], userVerification:'required', timeout:60000 };
      if (location.hostname) o.rpId = location.hostname;
      var a = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey: o });
      if (!a) return;
      var pin = localStorage.getItem('local_pin_rhn') || window.userCloudPin;
      if (!pin) { localStorage.removeItem(K(u)); refresh(); SW({ icon:'info', title:'Masukkan PIN Dulu', text:'PIN di perangkat ini sudah direset. Masukkan PIN sekali, lalu aktifkan sidik jari lagi di Pengaturan.' }); return; }
      var inp = document.getElementById('app-pin'); if (inp) inp.value = pin;
      await window.verifyPin();
    } catch(e){
      if (manual && e && e.name !== 'NotAllowedError') SW({ icon:'error', title:'Sidik Jari Gagal', text:'Gunakan PIN untuk membuka aplikasi.' });
    } finally { window.__bioBusy = false; }
  };

  // tampil / auto-prompt saat layar PIN muncul
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    refresh();
    var ps = document.getElementById('pin-screen'); if (!ps) return;
    var was = ps.style.display !== 'none';
    new MutationObserver(function(){
      var now = ps.style.display !== 'none';
      if (now && !was) { setTimeout(function(){ refresh(); if (enabled() && inVerify() && !document.querySelector('.swal2-container')) window.rhnBioUnlock(false); }, 700); }
      else refresh();
      was = now;
    }).observe(ps, { attributes:true, attributeFilter:['style'] });
    if (was) setTimeout(function(){ refresh(); if (enabled() && inVerify() && !document.querySelector('.swal2-container')) window.rhnBioUnlock(false); }, 1200);

    // tawaran sekali setelah berhasil masuk
    var app = document.getElementById('app-screen');
    if (app) new MutationObserver(function(){
      if (app.style.display !== 'block') return;
      var u = uid(); if (!u || enabled() || localStorage.getItem(ASK(u))) return;
      localStorage.setItem(ASK(u), '1');
      setTimeout(async function(){
        if (!(await supported())) return;
        var r = await SW({ icon:'question', title:'Aktifkan Sidik Jari?', text:'Lain kali buka aplikasi cukup dengan sidik jari, tanpa ketik PIN.', showCancelButton:true, confirmButtonText:'Aktifkan', cancelButtonText:'Nanti' });
        if (r && r.isConfirmed) window.rhnBioEnable();
      }, 2500);
    }).observe(app, { attributes:true, attributeFilter:['style'] });
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
